answer: Farming becomes a lotus bet on surviving 71 epochs of grading, and every vertex settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 71 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
